about_the_game:
Caved In is a chaotic co-op action-puzzle game for 2–8 players where teamwork is essential! Play locally or online with friends as you work together to solve tricky challenges and escape the cave.

Each level is built around cooperation. Push blocks, climb platforms, protect your friends, and figure out how to move as a team without leaving anyone behind.

All levels can be played no matter how many players you have!
